Dashboard data for the Cytek Aurora 3L last updated on 2026-02-25

First Column: Gain Gain (Voltage) values set for instrument after QC. Changes over time reflective of laser health. Second Column: rCV Percentage Robust Coefficient of Variation (rCV) after QC. Higher values reflect decreased resolution between positive and negative for that detector.

For additional information concerning individual parameter tabs, navigate to the Help page.

About

This dashboard contains the visualized QC data for the Cytek cytometers at the Sydney Cytometry Core Facility

For additional flow cytometry resources, visit our website

This dashboard was created with Quarto, based on work by David Rach.
